import math

import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model: int = 128, max_len: int = 5000):
        super().__init__()
        pe = torch.zeros(1, max_len, d_model)
        position = torch.arange(0, max_len, dtype=torch.float).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = torch.exp(
            torch.arange(0, d_model, 2).float() * (-math.log(10000.0) / d_model)
        )
        pe[0, :, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[0, :, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return x + self.pe[:, : x.size(1), :]


class RecoveredModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        input_dim: int = 64,
        d_model: int = 128,
        nhead: int = 8,
        num_encoder_layers: int = 2,
        num_decoder_layers: int = 1,
        dim_feedforward: int = 256,
        dropout: float = 0.1,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Linear(input_dim, d_model)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(d_model)
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model,
            nhead=nhead,
            dim_feedforward=dim_feedforward,
            dropout=dropout,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.transformer_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            encoder_layer, num_layers=num_encoder_layers
        )
        decoder_layer = nn.TransformerDecoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model,
            nhead=nhead,
            dim_feedforward=dim_feedforward,
            dropout=dropout,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.transformer_decoder = nn.TransformerDecoder(
            decoder_layer, num_layers=num_decoder_layers
        )
        self.output_layer = nn.Linear(d_model, input_dim)

    def forward(self, src: torch.Tensor, tgt: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        src_e = self.pos_encoder(self.embedding(src))
        tgt_e = self.pos_encoder(self.embedding(tgt))
        memory = self.transformer_encoder(src_e)
        out = self.transformer_decoder(tgt_e, memory)
        return self.output_layer(out)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from model_def import RecoveredModel


def main():
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    sd = torch.load("/app/weights.pt", map_location="cpu")
    data = torch.load("/app/dataset.pt", map_location="cpu")
    src, tgt = data["src_sequences"], data["tgt_sequences"]

    model = RecoveredModel()
    missing, unexpected = model.load_state_dict(sd, strict=True), None
    print("load_state_dict:", missing)
    model.eval()

    crit = nn.MSELoss()
    with torch.no_grad():
        base = crit(model(src, tgt), tgt).item()
    print("original MSE:", base)

    for name, p in model.named_parameters():
        p.requires_grad = name.startswith("output_layer")

    # features are fixed (all frozen layers, eval mode) -> closed-form ridge fit
    with torch.no_grad():
        feats = model.transformer_decoder(
            model.pos_encoder(model.embedding(tgt)),
            model.transformer_encoder(model.pos_encoder(model.embedding(src))),
        ).reshape(-1, 128)
    Y = tgt.reshape(-1, 64)
    X = torch.cat([feats, torch.ones(feats.size(0), 1)], dim=1).double()
    A = X.T @ X + 1e-4 * torch.eye(X.size(1), dtype=torch.float64)
    W = torch.linalg.solve(A, X.T @ Y.double())
    with torch.no_grad():
        model.output_layer.weight.copy_(W[:-1].T.float())
        model.output_layer.bias.copy_(W[-1].float())
        new = crit(model(src, tgt), tgt).item()
    print("closed-form MSE:", new)

    if not (new < base):
        opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.output_layer.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
        for _ in range(500):
            opt.zero_grad()
            loss = crit(model(src, tgt), tgt)
            loss.backward()
            opt.step()
        with torch.no_grad():
            new = crit(model(src, tgt), tgt).item()
        print("tuned MSE:", new)

    assert new < base

    # sanity: only output_layer differs
    new_sd = model.state_dict()
    diff = [k for k in sd if not torch.equal(sd[k], new_sd[k])]
    print("changed keys:", diff)
    assert set(diff) <= {"output_layer.weight", "output_layer.bias"}
    assert set(new_sd.keys()) == set(sd.keys())

    model.eval()
    scripted = torch.jit.script(model)
    scripted.save("/app/model.pt")

    # verify deliverable
    m = torch.jit.load("/app/model.pt")
    m.load_state_dict(torch.load("/app/weights.pt", map_location="cpu"))
    m.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        print("reloaded-with-orig-weights MSE:", crit(m(src, tgt), tgt).item())
    m2 = torch.jit.load("/app/model.pt")
    m2.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        print("model.pt MSE:", crit(m2(src, tgt), tgt).item())
    print("BASE", base, "NEW", new)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
